svg.title: The anthropic loop as a spiral
svg.desc: A rising spiral drawn as a single line in stacked loops. The top turn, the only one in full, carries the five states: E1 Displacement, E2 Accumulation, E3 Saturation, E4 Return, E5 Bifurcation, linked by conditional transitions, with a possible transfer arrest and an early return towards the emitter S. The two lower, increasingly faint turns are earlier iterations; the line ends at the top in E1′, a possible next cycle.
